0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOTTALK_00175_MUTAMIX_000_000
0.description: Process of shifty-making is of big help-use. First, be taking five need-not materia, yes? Melty-mix this one, mixy-melt that one, squeeze and squash, then bigeyes! Five need-not are reborn as one shiny-new!

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOTTALK_00175_MUTAMIX_000_001
1.description: What kind of materia is reborn? Such knowings do not rattle Mutamix's braincase. Maybe new materia is worth much jinglyshine; maybe it is even more scrappyjunk than five before. Shifty-making is exciting chance-game, yes?

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOTTALK_00175_SYSTEM_000_005
2.description: Mutamix will perform materia transmutation for you at any time, free of charge. Bring the goblin five pieces of unwanted materia, and he will transform them into a single new piece to use as you see fit.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMATERIASLOTTALK_00175_SYSTEM_000_006
3.description: That said, materia transmutation remains an inexact science. As for what manner of materia will emerge each time Mutamix works his wonders, not even the goblin genius himself can say.
